_comment: OFF-BALL DASH COMMITMENT. dt270 data only, one field, fully reversible, no exe byte touched. THE ONLY dt270 FIELD THAT REACHES OFF-BALL RUNNING AT ALL - and it changes the TEXTURE of the runs you already get, never how many run or how aggressive the team is. WHAT IT IS. basePosition.forceDashDistOffence (float at struct offset 392) is the distance-to-target above which an off-ball ATTACKING player is allowed to sprint rather than ease off toward his run target. Consumer 0x143da92c0, reached from match::player::ActionSpaceRun::vf13 (0x1441eb5d0, call at 0x1441eb6d9). THE READ, CONFIRMED FROM THE IMAGE THIS SESSION: at 0x143da9401 the code does 'cmp byte [r14+0x28d], 0' - the same attacking flag DiagonalRun::vf3 tests at 0x143e05163 - and on the OFFENCE side falls into 0x143da9414 'movss xmm7, [r12+0x188]', i.e. this field, offset 0x188 = 392. The defence side jumps to 0x143da9420 instead. The threshold is then used at 0x143da95a3 as 'comiss xmm9, xmm7 / jbe skip' with xmm9 the remaining distance, so THE SPRINT BLOCK RUNS ONLY WHILE distance > threshold. LOWERING the field therefore makes a runner hold the sprint until he is much closer to the space instead of easing off at 15 m out. 15 -> 8 is a 47% cut and is meant to be obvious. EVIDENCE. (b-disassembly, re-read by me this session) the branch, the read and the compare at the addresses above. (a-emulated, earlier probe, 10 rows over both branches and both fields) on the OFFENCE branch xmm7 at the compare equals this field EXACTLY (15->15, 40->40, 3->3, 99->99); on the DEFENCE branch it is 24.0 for every input because 0x143da9553 rebuilds it from exe literals - which is the known forceDashDistDefence trap, and the reason that sibling field is DEAD. build/dt270_liveness.json records this field as status 'read' with a single high-confidence reader, 0x143da9414 in 0x143da92c0. Current value reads 15 via 'gameplay_tune get basePosition forceDashDistOffence', and it is NOT among the 7 fields that differ from pristine, so current == stock. WHY IT IS AGGRESSION-NEUTRAL. It is downstream of the whole selection layer. No dt270 field is read by any selector vf4, vf5 or vf6 - a depth-5 direct-call closure of all 109 off-ball virtual methods intersected with the liveness map returns 20 fields, none of them in a selector. This cannot add a runner, cannot change who runs, and cannot move the attack level. TRADE-OFF. It is global to both teams and it does make off-ball movement look more urgent - if you count visual urgency as aggression, this is the one 'partly' in the set. It also only bites when a run target is more than a few metres away, so in a congested box you will see nothing. WHAT YOU WILL SEE: runners arriving at pace instead of coasting into the space over the last 15 m, and a wider spread of arrival timings between a short run and a long one. WHAT WOULD FALSIFY IT: off-ball movement looks identical, or players overrun their targets and have to check back. THE OPPOSITE EXPERIMENT, if you want it: 'python tools/gameplay_tune.py set basePosition.forceDashDistOffence=25' makes them ease off EARLY and only sprint the long runs - a strolling, late-acceleration look. REVERT: python tools/gameplay_tune.py set basePosition.forceDashDistOffence=15

edits._note: 15 -> 8 (stock 15, never modified). Distance-to-target above which an off-ball attacker may sprint. Sole reader 0x143da9414 in 0x143da92c0; compare at 0x143da95a3.
